Ireland vs Australia: Mack Hansen out with injury as Nick Timoney replaces suspended Dan Sheehan for Nations Championship clash
Wednesday 25 November 2026 16:19, UK
Mack Hansen has been ruled out of Ireland's starting XV to face Australia in this Friday's Nations Championship finals clash.
Ulster's Jacob Stockdale will replace him on the wing, alongside Robert Baloucoune, who scored twice during Ireland's 20-17 win against South Africa last Saturday.
Suspended hooker Dan Sheehan has been replaced by Nick Timoney, after he was banned for two matches for a croc-roll tackle during his side's match against the Springboks.
